title: the Black
, Bishop of Hippo
, Illuminator of Ethiopia
name: Moses
father among the saints Augustine
martyr Gebre Michael
venerable Fathers of the Monastery of the Caves at Kyiv who repose in the Further Caves
troparia: (Tone 1) Dweller of the wilderness and angel in the body,* you were a wonder-worker, our God-bearing father Moses!* You received heavenly gifts* through fasting, vigil and prayer:* Healing the sick and the souls of those drawn to you by faith:* Glory to Him Who gave you strength!* Glory to Him Who granted you a crown!* Glory to Him Who through you grants healing to all!
kontakia: (Tone 4) You upbraided your people and spat on the devil* and noetically shone brighter than the sun.* You guide our souls by the light of your life and thought.
